decisions.reason: The cover-text decision does not change the separate obligation to provide publication-readiness guidance; that requirement already has an independent same-message update from item 9.
Cover text and printed cover presentation do not alter the Chapter 12 heading and subtitle hierarchy.
Adding appropriate text to the cover does not change the editorial criteria or chapter mapping used to assess chapter illustrations.
The cover presentation decision does not change the separate publisher-attribution content discussed in item 3.
The requirement to include cover text has no necessary effect on chapter-image aspect ratio or cropping.
The cover design change does not modify the manuscript's editorial-polish objective or its approved prose.
Adding text to the paperback cover does not change the established placement of chapter images at the beginning of chapters.

The source cover decision does not necessarily change the title page or its existing rule about removing the literal newline artifact; the separate title-page question is not resolved by this cover MODIFY.
The cover-text decision does not change which client-edited manuscript revision is authoritative; that requirement's same-message update comes from the separate track-changes statement.
